panels.title: Agents in production on the chassis
panels.description: Agents with at least one ok run in production in the last seven days (docs/specs/metrics.md). The query needs `environment="prod"`, and the chassis sets no environment label: the production scrape adds it (suggested: the name and value). Until a scrape adds it, this panel shows no data. No target until the first real week sets the baseline.

panels.title: Good tasks per week
panels.description: Ok runs minus failed evaluator scorings, over the last seven days, summed over agents. It is a lower bound: each failed scoring is subtracted, including retries that later passed.

panels.title: First-attempt pass rate
panels.description: Gated runs that passed on attempt 1 over gated runs, per agent, exact.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, mode) (rate(chassis_gate_first_attempt_passes_total[5m])) / sum by (agent, mode) (rate(chassis_gate_runs_total[5m]))

panels.title: Task success rate
panels.description: Ok runs over runs started, per agent and interface.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, interface) (rate(chassis_run_duration_seconds_count{status="ok"}[5m])) / sum by (agent, interface) (rate(chassis_requests_total[5m]))

panels.title: p95 run latency, and the chassis's share of it
panels.description: The run p95 and the engine call p95 per agent. The gap between them is roughly the chassis's share. suggested: a stage budget of 25 ms p50 and 50 ms p95 (022 H-6), recorded, not enforced.

options.content:
**Formula:** hours from `agentctl new` to a passing demo, by someone new

**Source:** a timed run of `agentctl new` (`packages/agentctl`) by a new user

**Target on record:** under a day

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.

**Formula:** hours from a chassis tag to the last ring

**Source:** the ring rollout record of each chassis release

**Target on record:** none yet

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.

panels.title: Escapes: passed the gate, then bad feedback

options.content:
**Formula:** runs with `evaluator_calls{outcome="pass"}` and later `chassis_feedback_total{label="bad"}` (or a score below 0.5), per week

**Source:** the gate scores and user feedback on each run's trace in the trace store (`FeedbackPort`, the score named `spec.harness.rubric`); a per-run join PromQL cannot do

**Target on record:** if online scores fall more than 10 points under offline, review the golden set

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.

panels.title: Cost per good task
panels.description: Model cost over the last seven days, every route and the judge included, over good tasks. Only routes in `spec.observability.prices` have a cost. Target: the G-5 break-even. Good tasks here are a lower bound: each failed scoring is subtracted, including retries that later passed. So this cost reads high by the same bias.

options.content:
**Formula:** blocks on golden inputs / golden inputs

**Source:** an eval run of the golden set (`packages/eval-kit/golden/`) through the guardrail

**Target on record:** below 1% false positives (ADR-008)

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.

panels.title: Guardrail unavailable rate
panels.description: The other half of guardrail false blocks: checks the guardrail could not answer, over runs started.

options.content:
**Formula:** stream secret guard hits that reached a client; red-team misses

**Source:** `python -m eval_kit.redteam` (the misses); a hit that reached a client has no counter: the chassis counts a block, not a leak

**Target on record:** zero; red team 18 of 18

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.

panels.title: Judge agreement and stored gate scores (138 CH-18)
panels.description: How often the main and the shadow judge agree, when `spec.harness.shadow_evaluator` is set. The scores the store missed are the next panel.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, pair) (rate(chassis_evaluator_agreement_total{agree="true"}[5m])) / sum by (agent, pair) (rate(chassis_evaluator_agreement_total[5m]))

panels.title: Gate scores not stored
panels.description: Gate scores `FeedbackPort` did not store, per hour. The escapes join needs every one.

panels.title: Gate fallback rate and fail-open rate
panels.description: Fallbacks over sync gate runs (target below 10%, the line), and fail-opens over gate runs (alert above suggested: 1% over 15 minutes, 117 X-3).

panels.title: Gate reruns stopped by the budget
panels.description: Reruns the run's one budget stopped, per hour, by `timeout` or `budget` (017 H-4).

options.content:

**Source:** the load run (`python -m load_tools.run_matrix`); the chassis does not export its own CPU or memory

**Target on record:** 0.05 to 0.1 vCPU, 128 to 256 MiB (ADR-001)

The chassis exports no family for it, so it is a weekly number in the `record-measurement` note, not a query.
